title: Nose Landing Gear & Bay Doors
summary: Retractable single-strut dual-wheel nose landing gear with steerable oleo shock strut and flush serrated bay doors.
role: Supports forward aircraft weight on the ground, provides taxi steering, and retracts cleanly into the forward fuselage.
materials: High-strength aerospace steel/titanium strut with composite bay doors.
